verdict.rationale: There is no documented data-export feature. Programmatic access offers only indirect paths out: post-call webhooks push call data to your own server, the Pathways API, CLI and MCP server let you inspect and manage calls and pathways, and bringing your own Twilio account keeps phone numbers under your control. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all account data (call logs, transcripts, recordings, pathways, memory, knowledge, voices), named open export formats, a documented process for porting numbers out, and any independent confirmation that leaving is practical.
